text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf announced her retirement 
from active competition. Moving forward, 
she intended to transition to a support 
role and dedicate herself to the future of 
the Umamusume world.

Even after she steps down, the thrill of 
the races won't fade. New brilliance 
awaits, such as the Triple Tiara. In this 
way, she subtly hints at her high hopes 
for Mejiro Ramonu.

Claiming that Symboli Rudolf's retirement 
had nothing to do with her as long as she 
kept running, Mejiro Ramonu nonetheless 
ran with uncharacteristic roughness.
